notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (requests + bs4) worked fully - robots.txt has no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot disallow (only param/controller-path disallows), all pages returned 200. No Playwright/Chrome needed. TREE: built from union of sitemap_4-category.xml + the site's server-rendered mega-menu (js-cmp-megamenu block present in raw HTML, no JS execution needed) + each category page's own subcategory tile strip (data-order tiles) + breadcrumb (Tanagra Home > ... ) confirming h1/canonical match on every leaf recorded. Top nav has 10 sections: New Arrivals, Online Exclusive, Home Decor, Dining, Home Fragrance, Lifestyle & Gaming, Brands, Gifts, Shop by Room, Our Stories, Last Remaining Pieces, Available By Request, Gift Card - no Storage/Organization section anywhere in the nav. QTY: read from data-total-product-count attribute + matching '[N] / N items' progress-label text on each category's own listing page (server-rendered, confirmed identical between the two sources on every leaf). Parent aggregator pages (Throws & Decorative Pillows=32, Table Linen=72) were confirmed as pure roll-ups and their own URL/qty dropped per parent-category-URL rule since valid subcategories exist; Throws & Decorative Pillows children sum exactly to 32 (18+14); Table Linen's 72 does not equal the sum of its 4 children's counts (51) which is expected since the parent total can include cross-tagged items - not used as evidence of a bug, simply not recorded per the parent-URL rule. EXCLUDED (checked, not qualifying): Napkin Accessories (14 items, e.g. Hyacinthe/Babylone/Nathalie Napkin Ring) are silver-plated napkin RINGS/holders - hardware accessories, not textile (same boundary as curtain rings/hooks) and not storage - dropped as an orphaned child of Table Linen. Decorative Boxes & Baskets and its 3 children (Decorative Boxes 46, Baskets 11, Tissue Boxes 14) plus the separately-nested Tea & Candy Boxes (7, under the same Decorative Boxes & Baskets parent) and Cutlery Boxes (5, nested under Dining>Cutlery) were inspected product-by-product: Decorative Boxes = bonbonnieres/trinket/jewelry/playing-card boxes (Barocco Trinket Box, Alphabet Collection Bonbonniere, Visi Playing Card Box); Baskets = waste bins/wastepaper baskets (Hilding Waste Basket, Drill Waste Basket, Brennan Waste Bin) not organizational storage baskets; Tissue Boxes = decorative tissue-box covers; Tea & Candy Boxes = candy dishes/bonbonnieres; Cutlery Boxes = luxury cutlery presentation cases. All are primary-purpose decorative/gifting/presentation objects per the site's own Home Decor / Dining hierarchy, not genuine storage-organization products (site has zero Storage/Organization nav section) - excluded from storage_rows per storage.md Sec 23/24 (decorative-vs-storage; a product that can technically hold something is not Storage unless its primary purpose is explicitly storage). Also checked and excluded as non-textile/non-storage: Wall Decor (wall plates + mirrors only, no tapestries/fabric wall art), Desk Accessories (pens, clocks, blotters, pencil cups - decorative desk items). Placemats/Napkins/Runners & Table Cloths kept as Textile because the site itself files them under Dining > Table Linen (a textile-labeled parent), consistent with textile.md Sec 7.
